_note: No per-language override by default. Measured 2026-11-08 on synthetic clips: Omnilingual 300M CTC writes Hindi in Devanagari in 2 of 5 clips and in Urdu script in 3 (no language hint possible); Whisper small int8 (sherpa-onnx) keeps Devanagari but stopped decoding after ~3 s of Hindi speech in every clip, so it is not routed here. A deployment that installs an IndicConformer pack adds e.g. "hi": "indicconformer-hi-int8".
